  app.post("/admin/api/logout", async (_req, reply) => {
    reply.clearCookie("ssai_admin", { path: "/" });
    return { ok: true };
  });

  app.get("/health", async () => ({ status: "ok", plane: "control" }));

  // ── Sessions (PRD §11, §12) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  app.post("/v1/sessions", async (req, reply) => {
    const body = (req.body ?? {}) as { channel_id?: string; device_type?: string; country?: string };
    if (!body.channel_id) return reply.code(400).send({ error: "channel_id is required" });

    const sessionId = `sess_${randomUUID()}`;
    await sessionsRepo.ensureSession(pool, {
      id: sessionId,
      channelId: body.channel_id,
      deviceType: body.device_type ?? "web",
      country: body.country ?? null,
    });
    await eventsRepo.appendEvent(pool, {
      eventId: randomUUID(),
      eventType: "session_created",
      sessionId,
      channelId: body.channel_id,
    });

    // Signed playback token (PRD §57): the data plane verifies it before serving.
    const token = signSession(sessionId, body.channel_id, sessionSecret, { ttlSeconds: sessionTtlSeconds });
    return {
      session_id: sessionId,
      channel_id: body.channel_id,
      playback_token: token,
      playback_url: `${dataPlaneUrl}/v1/hls/${token}/${body.channel_id}/master.m3u8`,
    };
  });

  app.get("/v1/sessions/:id", async (req, reply) => {
    const { id } = req.params as { id: string };
    const session = await sessionsRepo.getSession(pool, id);
    return session ?? reply.code(404).send({ error: "not_found" });
  });

  // ── Ad Decision (PRD §15, §16, §35) ──────────────────────────────────────
  app.post("/v1/ad-decision", async (req, reply) => {
    const body = (req.body ?? {}) as {
      session_id?: string;
      channel_id?: string;
      opportunity_id?: string;
      external_break_id?: string;
      duration?: number;
      seed?: string;
    };
    if (!body.channel_id || !body.opportunity_id || typeof body.duration !== "number") {
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: "channel_id, opportunity_id and duration are required" });
    }

    const sessionId = body.session_id ?? `sess_${randomUUID()}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const opportunity: AdOpportunity = {
      opportunityId: body.opportunity_id,
      channelId: body.channel_id,
      ...(body.external_break_id ? { externalBreakId: body.external_break_id } : {}),
      breakStart: now,
      breakDuration: body.duration,
      source: "cue_out",
      signalType: "cue_out",
    };
    const session: SessionContext = { sessionId, channelId: body.channel_id };

    // Inventory from Postgres.
    const [creatives, campaignMap] = await Promise.all([

      campaignsRepo.campaignsAsMap(pool),
